notes_for_editor: OpenStreetMap-only record. The tower carries tower:type=observation and no emergency=fire_lookout tag, so it may not be a fire lookout at all; the kind 'tower' is still safe. Mapcarta labels it Essex while the nearby reservation is in Ipswich, so the town needs checking before any change (it may sit near the Essex/Ipswich line). Neither the cached NHLR nor the cached FFLOS Massachusetts index lists an Essex or Ipswich entry. The archived copy of the OSM source PDF (web.archive.org, 2014) did not load, so the current Mass.gov copy was read; the refuge observation tower it mentions is not tied to these coordinates. Status, build date and builder are unknown.
